methodology: Paired seeds, alternating order, one excluded warmup per mode/scenario. Same source texts, player CPU/heap/Memory/wall budgets and SDK interface. The new trusted SDK captures array intrinsics; source text is therefore not identical. Match timing includes process startup, all ticks, gzip+fsync, process shutdown and final path publication; validation preparation and replay verification measured separately. No database, queue wait or browser rendering. Parent CPU and billed player CPU are reported separately; only the new runner reports complete child-process CPU and peak RSS. Separate optional resource probes include driver startup, module loading and match execution, excluding replay verification. Their CPU covers waited descendants; tree RSS is sampled every 20ms plus ps duration, and largest-process RSS is a kernel high-water mark. Probe sampling does not run during paired timing samples.
